name: open-ping
description: Open-source, self-hosted uptime monitoring and public status page running entirely in your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts && npm run test:platform
scripts.db:migrate:prod: node scripts/prod-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c .wrangler.prod.jsonc
scripts.release:check: release-kit check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

MASTER_KEY.description: Encrypts the credentials OpenPing stores. Must be 32 random bytes in base64: run `openssl rand -base64 32`, or use the generator at [openping.n8builds.dev/install](https://openping.n8builds.dev/install#generate). **Save a copy in your password manager**: Cloudflare never shows it again.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Unlocks the first-run setup page until you finish it, so nobody else can claim your new install. Generate another value the same way (`openssl rand -base64 32`) and keep it: the setup page asks for it.

WORKERS_PLAN.description: Your Cloudflare Workers plan, `free` or `paid`. On Free each 12-minute run checks about 24 monitors and leaves the rest for the next run. [More](https://github.com/n8watkins/open-ping/blob/main/docs/FREE_TIER.md)

WAITLIST_ENABLED.description: Leave `false`. Only the OpenPing project's own site collects the Hosted waitlist.

HOME_PAGE.description: Leave `status`, so visitors see your status page at `/`. Only the OpenPing project's own site uses `landing`.

DB.description: OpenPing's database: monitors, check results, incidents and settings. The deploy creates its tables.
